'아주 뜨거운' 차의 오즈는 약 8.16배입니다(3.93–16.9). 차를 따른 뒤 마시기까지 기다린 시간도 비교했습니다. 2분 미만에 마신 사람을 4분 이상 기다린 사람과 비교했습니다. 식도암 오즈는 빨리 마신 쪽이 약 5.41배입니다(2.63–11.1). 이는 관찰된 연관이며 인과관계를 확정하지 못합니다. 마신 온도를 기억해 답한 데 따른 오류도 가능합니다.

primary_evidence.level: Full article XML including abstract, methods, results and discussion read directly
quotes: Participants 300 histologically proved cases of oesophageal squamous cell carcinoma and 571 matched neighbourhood controls in the case-control study and 48 582 participants in the cohort study.
Main outcome measure Odds ratio of oesophageal squamous cell carcinoma associated with drinking hot tea.

compared with drinking lukewarm or warm tea, drinking hot tea (odds ratio 2.07, 95% confidence interval 1.28 to 3.35) or very hot tea (8.16, 3.93 to 16.9) was associated with an increased risk of oesophageal cancer.

compared with drinking tea four or more minutes after being poured, drinking tea 2-3 minutes after pouring (2.49, 1.62 to 3.83) or less than two minutes after pouring (5.41, 2.63 to 11.1) was associated with a significantly increased risk.
As in all case-control studies, however, data on the amount and temperature of consumed tea can be subject to information bias.
Nonetheless, we acknowledge that the nature and strength of the association needs to be established in prospective studies.
